title: CanvasGroup makes child shader with low alpha (≈0.1667) invisible in Compatibility renderer
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.1.stable.official, v4.7.2.stable.official, 4.8-dev4

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev4 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1200 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon (TM) Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.12044.58002) - AMD Ryzen 5 7530U with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 13.85 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In the Compatibility renderer, a Sprite2D that has a simple canvas_item shader writing a low constant alpha becomes completely invisible when it is a child of a CanvasGroup.
- Changing the alpha from 0.16674 to 0.16675 makes the sprite appear again.
- If the parent is changed from CanvasGroup to a regular Node2D, the sprite is visible at both values.
- The issue does not occur in the Mobile and Forward+ renderers.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a project with Compatibility renderer
- Create a new scene with CanvasGroup as root.
- Add a Sprite2D as child.
- Assign any texture to the Sprite2D (GradientTexture2D).
- Create a new ShaderMaterial with the following shader and assign it to the Sprite2D:
```
shader_type canvas_item;
void fragment() {
	COLOR = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.16674); // invisible
	// COLOR = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.16675); // visible
}
```
- **Sprite is invisible**
- Change the alpha to 0.16675 → sprite becomes visible.
- Change the parent from CanvasGroup to Node2D → both alpha values work correctly.
- Switch project to Mobile renderer → both values work even under CanvasGroup.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-godot-shader.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31486408/test-godot-shader.zip)
